description: This file defines the TemplateDirIterator class within the Twig	he Util namespace. The class extends IteratorIterator and overrides the current() and key() methods to return the file contents and key as a string, respectively. It appears to be a utility class for iterating over template directories, reading file contents.

classes.name: TemplateDirIterator
classes.description: A utility class extending IteratorIterator to iterate over template directories, providing methods to get current file contents and keys as strings.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the contents of the current file in the iteration.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the key (likely filename or filepath) of the current element as a string.
